name: Palmetto Stays
what: A small hotel-booking agency in Miami. We find and book hotels in Miami and Miami Beach.
hours: Every day, 8 AM to 10 PM Eastern Time.

miami_beach.name: Miami Beach
miami_beach.about: South Beach and the beachfront: Ocean Drive, Collins Avenue, Mid-Beach.

downtown.name: Downtown Miami and Brickell
downtown.about: The city side of Biscayne Bay: Brickell, Downtown, Edgewater and the airport.

policies: We book one room per call. For several rooms or a group, we take a message and an agent calls back.
Prices are for the whole stay in US dollars. Hotel taxes and resort fees that are paid at the hotel are shown separately when the hotel tells us.
Whether a room can be cancelled for free, and until when, depends on the rate. We always say which before booking.
We never take card details over the phone. Payment is by a secure link.
